Appearance:

Order 
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of BNSS for grant of anticipatory bail.
The applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.201/2025 registered at Police Station University District Gwalior for offence punishable under Sections 420, 120(B) of IPC.

The prosecution case, in brief, is that Acting Inspector Yogesh Baraiya received information from an informant that the applicant and other accused persons used fake and forged Diploma in Education (D.Ed.) mark sheets to obtain teacher appointments in the Education Department.
On confidential verification, it was found that the Board of Secondary Education, Bhopal, had not issued the said D.Ed. mark sheets.
Further investigation revealed that the applicant and others had obtained and used forged D.Ed. mark sheets.

Consequently, a case was registered against the applicant and seven other NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:4438 2 MCRC-5408-2026 accused under Sections 420, 468, 471, and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code, and the matter was taken up for investigation.
During the investigation, information received from the Board of Secondary Education, Bhopal, confirmed that the mark sheets were not issued by it.

Information was also sought from the District Education Officer, Gwalior, regarding Shri Sahib Singh Kushwaha, son of Sahab Singh Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125149297/
1 Khemraj, who was shown as posted at Government Primary School Ranjipur, Kherwa, Bhitarwar as on 24.10.2025.

sentences.text:
Photocopies of the mark sheets revealed that the applicant had not obtained B.Ed.
qualification and that the D.Ed. mark sheet for the year 2013 bearing Roll No. 4514572 was issued to another student.
The investigation is still incomplete.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has not committed any offence and is neither directly nor indirectly involved in the alleged crime.
The investigation in the present case is still incomplete.
The case is purely documentary in nature, and police custody is not required for any recovery or interrogation.

The period of offence mentioned in the FIR is from 01.01.1996 to 30.06.2024, indicating that the FIR has been lodged after a delay of approximately 28 years, which renders the prosecution story suspicious at first glance.

The FIR has not been registered on the complaint of any individual or victim but is based on information provided by an STF officer,
thereby indicating that the matter pertains to departmental or administrative verification rather than necessitating immediate arrest.

More than 30 persons have been arrayed as accused in the FIR,
and no specific, direct, or individual role has been attributed to the applicant.
There is no NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:4438 3 MCRC-5408-2026 likelihood of the applicant absconding or evading the course of justice.
It is further submitted that in the event of arrest, the applicant's reputation in society would be seriously prejudiced, and he would be subjected to unnecessary harassment.
The applicant is ready and willing to cooperate with the investigation and to abide by all conditions that may be imposed by this Hon'ble Court.
Accordingly, the applicant prays for grant of anticipatory bail.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard the counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the totality of facts and circumstances of the case, the role attributed to the applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that the applicant has made out a case for grant of anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, it is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for his appearance before it during the course of investigation or before the trial Court concerned during trial, as the case may be.
